artifact_verification.verification_scope: Official artifact download, provenance, complete producer/file/test inventory, hashes, original workload assertions and phase data review only; no local project build, test, formatter, lint or syntax check.

original_workload.original_receipt_scope: Original HTTP management and signed grants, actual kernel QUIC/TCP targets, original limits and four-scope durable accounting. One independent management login per active consumer, unchanged original rate limits.
original_receipt_limitations: one hosted process; not physical nodes or independently deployed relay runtimes
short-run samples cannot qualify cross-day soak, complete E2E or all bounded queues
original_workload.flow_ready_tuple_inventory: Exactly one of every wave in 0..2, pair in 0..19 and flow in 0..49; 3000 unique tuples.

exact_source_assertion_review.application_bytes: Each ready worker writes a 16-byte wave/pair/flow/NLCP payload and reads/asserts its exact echo before readiness.
exact_source_assertion_review.simultaneous_target_hold: The backend active-target sum is asserted equal to 1000 before and after the original two-second hold, for all three waves.
exact_source_assertion_review.drain: Each original worker shuts down, reads EOF and closes; each control owner closes; active backend counts must reach zero within the original five seconds.
exact_source_assertion_review.completed_targets: Each pair's completed backend count is asserted equal to (wave + 1) * 50.
exact_source_assertion_review.durable_accounting: For every pair after each wave, the original resource-scope quota readback must reach outstanding_bytes == 0 within five seconds, then asserts active_grants == 0 and spent_bytes == (wave + 1) * 50 * 32: 1600, 3200 and 4800 cumulative bytes per pair.
exact_source_assertion_review.accounting_observation_limit: The retained wave_drained records follow these assertions. They do not contain separate numeric readbacks for every quota scope; the receipt's broader four-scope description is not additional independent telemetry.
exact_source_assertion_review.physical_cleanup: After all waves, each original host stops and its exact UDP address can be rebound; each backend has active == 0, acknowledges listener-task cancellation and its exact TCP address can be rebound. Only then is all_owned_listeners_physically_released recorded.
exact_source_assertion_review.resource_interpretation: Final FD count is 27 and RSS is 245568 kB. Physical owned-listener release does not mean all process descriptors or allocations return to zero.

sampling.private_raw_digest_verification_limit: The private perf.data was intentionally not exported. Its size and SHA256 are hosted producer attestations retained in the verified artifact, not an independently rehashed local raw file.

limitations: Existing event timestamps are truncated to milliseconds; each internal boundary has an excluded one-millisecond band.
The third window is after-all-controls-recorded, including scheduler handoff, flow opening and any later hold, waves or teardown; it is not pure opening or currentness.
No absolute timestamp is inferred from flow_ready.open_microseconds, and no call graph is recorded.
Realtime/monotonic anchors at target start/end and existing one-second waits reject observed offset jumps; transient changes between observations cannot be ruled out.

interpretation: All original pair-window release workload assertions completed in this diagnostic run: 100 enrolled installations, 20 pairs, three waves of 1000 actual TCP targets with the original two-second simultaneous-load hold, exact payload/EOF, resource-scope durable-accounting assertions and physical owner cleanup. Original immutable leases, deadlines, quota gates, polling and the 660-second execution budget were retained.

The after-all-controls-recorded report covers 30.102818229 seconds and all three successful waves, holds, draining and final cleanup. Its 3269 samples include 732 curve25519 names (22.3922%), 528 serde names (16.1517%) and 554 sqlite3-prefixed names (16.9471%). These are descriptive symbol matches without a call graph, not disjoint elapsed-time cost attribution or a pure opening phase.

Setup wall time is 244.721 seconds, including the unchanged four 61-second rate-limit waits. Only 29 samples were captured in its window, including 20 Argon2 names. Target creation precedes perf attachment; early work can be missed and zero samples do not establish zero work.

The tested source includes ADR 0076's reuse of the exact same canonical signed claims within one invocation. The result establishes this run's behavior, without establishing a causal or statistical performance improvement: this runner is AMD EPYC 9V45 with four online CPUs, whereas the previous efebb7b failed run used EPYC 7763 with four online CPUs.

The previous third phase covered only the failed first-wave lifetime (about 9.0547 seconds), whereas this one spans three waves and cleanup (about 30.1028 seconds). Raw sample totals and percentages have different exposure and cannot be compared as equivalent workloads.

The receipt intentionally keeps passed=false, ac68_passed=false and sampling.acceptance_qualified=false despite original_workload_passed=true and diagnostic_passed=true. A separate exact-source sampling=none run is required for ordinary workload qualification.
limits: All historical failed workloads remain failed, including e226eec HTTP 403 PermissionRequired at 800 readiness records, efebb7b carrier loss at 640, and f3cfb45's expired-authority failure after its original hold despite 1000 readiness events.
No call graph, SQL duration, mutex wait, DB admission wait or per-open_stream cost was collected. User-space sampled CPU percentages are not elapsed wall-clock percentages.
One hosted process does not qualify 100 independent physical nodes, loaded external management/relay machines, every bounded queue, cross-day soak, full end-to-end acceptance or AC68.

Clock anchors reject observed offset changes and excessive uncertainty at the retained observations; transient realtime changes between anchors cannot be ruled out. One-millisecond quantization bands are excluded.

The official archive retains the complete original receipt, all 277 clock anchors, every producer output and all events. This focused evidence retains complete commands, tests and file manifest plus independently checked summaries.
